overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort Utilities (SDP) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Utilities Select Sector index. The fund provides 2x inverse exposure to a market cap-weighted index of S&P 500 utilities stocks. SDP was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
